alt: Exercise 3 is the third of five compulsory exercises in a 1 hour 45 minute, 50-mark paper. It is worth 9 marks, tests R1 to R4, uses the longest text on the paper, and that same text feeds the Exercise 4 summary. All answers are in Urdu, without dictionaries.
caption: One long text, two exercises: understanding it well pays twice.

alt: How R1 to R4 apply: R1 finds the points for each heading, R2 recognises a point given as someone's view, R3 connects a point in one paragraph to a heading introduced in another, and R4 supplies an implied point when a heading calls for it.
caption: Points for one heading can be spread, stated as views, or only implied.

alt: A note must be specific (پانی کی کمی, not کچھ مسائل), complete enough to make sense (تیز دھوپ میں پودوں کا جھلس جانا, not دھوپ), one point only, and under the right heading. Noun phrases such as خرچ میں کمی، کیمیائی کھاد سے پاک غذا and پڑوسیوں سے میل جول work best.
caption: Brief, specific, one point, in the right place.

after: ## Mapping the text to the headings
alt: Five steps: read the headings first, read the whole text once, label each relevant detail with its heading letter on a second reading, check that each point sits under one heading only, and count the bullet lines to see how many points are expected.
caption: Headings first, then label the text, then count.

alt: Strong notes for the rooftop-gardening article under three headings: benefits (بازار کے خرچ میں کمی، کیمیائی کھاد سے پاک غذا، عمارت کا گرمیوں میں ٹھنڈا رہنا), difficulties (تیز دھوپ سے پودوں کا جھلسنا، گیلی مٹی سے چھت کو نقصان کا خدشہ) and the experts' advice (آسان پودوں سے آغاز، گملوں کے نیچے ٹرے).
caption: Each note is one specific point, under the heading it answers.

alt: Five weak notes: ٹماٹر، مرچیں اور پودینہ names crops, not a benefit; سستی اور صحت مند سبزیاں merges two benefits; دھوپ is too thin; پانی کی ٹرے، سایہ اور کھاد packs three tips into one note; پڑوسیوں سے ملاقات is a benefit placed under difficulties.
caption: Wrong kind of point, too many points, too little point, or the wrong heading.

alt: A note such as خرچ میں کمی converts into a summary sentence, گھر میں سبزیاں اگانے سے خرچ کم ہوتا ہے. The Exercise 4 summary is at most 100 words on an aspect of the same text, often one or two headings. Notes should be three to eight words, checked against the heading.
caption: Clear noun-phrase notes turn quickly into summary sentences.
